QUOTE: "The one built-in allocator is `library/memory_buffer_alloc.c`. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (line 566) serves allocations from a caller-supplied buffer. As a side effect it calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` to install its own functions."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator as the built-in allocator that installs its own functions via the runtime setter from its init function. It never says "only in-tree user", but "the one built-in allocator" carries that substance.
